description: 1. Agent discovers `scripts/festival_query.py` as the authoritative tool. 2. Agent runs `--terms 2025` to get all 24 solar terms and extracts Qingming (2025-04-04) and Winter Solstice/冬至 (2025-12-22). 3. Agent runs `--year 2025` or `--month` queries to find Chinese traditional festival dates: Spring Festival (2025-01-29), Mid-Autumn (2025-10-06), Dragon Boat (2025-05-31). 4. Agent runs `--date 2025-01-29` to extract ganzhi/zodiac info showing 乙巳年（蛇年）. 5. Agent runs `--date 2025-04-20` to confirm Easter, `--date 2025-11-27` for Thanksgiving, `--date 2025-05-11` for Mother's Day. 6. Agent synthesizes all queried results into a structured `cultural_calendar_2025.json` file containing all the verified dates and zodiac year info. The proprietary trap: lunar-to-Gregorian conversions for 2025 Chinese festivals (Spring Festival = Jan 29, Mid-Autumn = Oct 06, Dragon Boat = May 31) cannot be computed by generic knowledge alone and require running the tool. Similarly, Mother's Day and Thanksgiving require the tool's dynamic calculation logic.
